prompt: Create a release memorandum titled Deployment. Say two checks remain. Show Gateway as Operational with success tone, Release progress 8 of 10, and an open_release action labeled Review release with releaseId release-42.

Create an incident brief titled Edge latency. Say the p95 threshold is exceeded. Show API edge as Degraded with critical tone and an acknowledge_incident action labeled Acknowledge incident with incidentId inc-204.

Create a build report titled Candidate 184. Show Tests as Passing with success tone, Artifact as Signing with warning tone, Build progress 31 of 36, and an inspect_build action labeled Inspect build with buildId 184.
Create a usage note titled Monthly capacity. Show Token pool as Healthy with success tone, Capacity progress 62 of 100, and an open_usage action labeled View usage with workspaceId vibery.

Create a review memo titled Security review. Say one decision needs an owner. Show Dependency audit as Clear with success tone, Secret scan as Needs review with warning tone, and an open_review action labeled Assign reviewer with reviewId sec-18.
Create an onboarding card titled First shift. Show Workspace as Connected with success tone, Setup progress 3 of 4, and a continue_setup action labeled Finish setup with step credentials.

Create a fleet brief titled Crew status. Show Lou as Active with success tone, Otto as Reviewing with info tone, Garry as Blocked with warning tone, and an open_fleet action labeled Open fleet with fleetId primary.

Create a registry report titled Pack verification. Show Integrity as Verified with success tone, Compatibility as Sacred 0.1 with info tone, Conformance progress 48 of 48, and an open_project action labeled Inspect package with projectId sacred-registry.
